bibl.title: Soter, Sotas, and Dioscorus before the Governor: The First Authentic Court Record of a Roman Trial of Christians?
bibl.seg: Sabine R. Huebner, Soter, Sotas, and Dioscorus before the Governor: The First Authentic Court Record of a Roman Trial of Christians?
Journal of Late Antiquity 12 (2019) pp. 2-24, fig.
bibl.note: The Acta martyrum of Late Antiquity. - P. Mil. Vogl. VI, 287, a record from the court of the Roman governor of Egypt [to be dated to the middle of the third century CE]. - The charge of conspiracy. - The prosecuting party. - The lawyers. - Identification of the defendants. - The silence of the defendants. - Persecutions of Christians in Egypt. - Conclusion.
